Undoubtedly, the words sufficient cause as laid down in various authoritative pronouncement of Hon'ble Supreme Court to receive a liberal construction so as to advance substantial justice in case where no negligence, no in action or any want of bonafides is attributed to the appellant is concerned.

sentences.text: While considering the plea for condonation of delay, the court must not start with the merits of the main matter.
The court owes a duty to first ascertain the bona fides of the explanation offered by the party seeking condonation.

It is only if the sufficient cause assigned by the litigant and the opposition of the other side is equally balanced that the court may bring into aid the merits of the matter for the purpose of condoning the delay.
27. We are of the view that the question of limitation is not merely a technical consideration.
The rules of limitation are based on the principles of sound public policy and principles of equity.
We should not keep the 'Sword of Damocles' hanging over the head of the respondent for indefinite period of time to be determined at the whims and fancies of the appellants.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
In my view the explanation offered by the State on the ground that in cognate land reference cases modification was sought for was not substantive in so far as judgment and award is concerned and therefore cannot be said to be a sufficient cause to be considered for condonation of delay.
The length of the delay is a relevant matter which the court must take into consideration while considering whether the delay should be condoned or not.
While considering the plea for condonation of delay, the court must not start with the merits of the main matter.
The court owes a duty to first ascertain the bona fides of the explanation offered by the party seeking condonation.
It is only if the sufficient cause assigned by the litigant and the opposition of the other side is equally balanced that the court may bring into aid the merits of the matter for the purpose of condoning the delay.
The rules of limitation are based on the principles of sound public policy and principles of equity.
30. In Postmaster General and others v. Living Media India Limited, (2012) 3 SCC 563, this Court,
while dismissing the application for condonation of delay of 427 days in filing the Special Leave Special Land Acquisition Officer vs Motisinh Gulabsinh on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36166068/
